name: Japan Property Management Center Co.,Ltd.
summary: Japan Property Management Center Co.,Ltd. engages in leasing rental properties in Japan. The company is involved in renting condominiums and apartments; bulk leasing business; construction work; management/brokerage of rental properties; operation of senior housing; rent debt guarantee and rental management; insurance business; renovation; real estate sales brokerage business; delinquency guarantee business; and broadband business. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
